answer: Each identity maintains a continuous sequential computation thread rooted to a non-transferable ember of hardware attestation. Creating k sybil identities forces the attacker to provision k distinct exclusive hardware units that cannot be pooled, each advancing its thread with a fixed sequential delay of roughly 30 minutes per epoch; thus total wall-clock and capital scale as O(k). An honest agent pays the delay only once. If embers are forgeable the violet clustering in the attestation graph exposes the forks.
